checks.name: branch_lineage_and_git
checks.details: Compared the actual creation receipt to the preceding project revision, main parent and current resolved Git commit; creation kept main selected and did not alter Git checkout.
criteria: create/list/switch 记录父分支、fork revision 与 git ref。

checks.name: session_claim_context_identity
checks.details: The actual branch session and claim carry the created branch ID; complete L1 context carries the same identity. The prior main session and claim remain byte-equivalent JSON records and the source ledger bytes are unchanged.
criteria: Session/Event/Claim/Context/Evidence 有分支归属，明确共享 Source 与运行态隔离的边界。

commands: 在本项目验证工作分支的来源绑定与运行记录归属。
继续本次分支功能的实际开发验证。
limitations: Developer self-use of branch/context identity. The implementing agent performs these checks; this is not independent business acceptance or E4.
Evidence registration and return-to-main checks happen after this immutable observation; they are recorded in the separate self-use receipt.
